ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) coverage across the central and proximal regions, with 20% high-intensity (off-white) coverage concentrated at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark mass dominates the central fluke. Distinct high-intensity white/cream blobs are visible on the distal ends of both lobes. The left tip blob features thin, vertical low-intensity striations. The right tip blob features broader, high-contrast vertical bands and mottled pixel groups.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, obtuse V-shaped depression with an estimated angle of 135 degrees; vertical depth is minimal relative to the horizontal width of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serration along the trailing edge. Pixel-amplitude of peaks increases significantly at the transition points toward the distal tips, creating a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a symmetrical concave arc from the median notch to the outer tips, with the tips themselves showing a slight convex curvature toward the dorsal side.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular textured clusters of mixed intensity (tan, white, and dark grey) concentrated on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, corresponding to surface colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple fine-grained, light-colored linear pixel disruptions oriented vertically across the dark ventral surface of the right lobe, consistent with rake-mark patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological colonization and associated scarring on the extreme distal tips; visible vertical linear abrasions on the posterior section of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and asymmetrical interface between the high-intensity white patches and the low-intensity black central region, particularly on the inner edge of the right lobe tip.
